states.name: Mizuchi
states.title: Black-Hearted White Snake
states.description: Akame Mizuchi was ranked the second strongest among the Four Masters of the Onmyo Bureau. As a result, her shoulders were constantly weighed down with many responsibilities. She had to protect everyone from the oni, had to serve as a model for the onmyoji of her bureau, and had to obey the orders of the Inner Palace...

states.name: Mizuchi
states.title: Black-Hearted White Snake
states.description:
She loved the people, and she loved the disciples of her bureau. Her desire to protect them was completely sincere. But at the same time, before she even realized it, there was a voice that had begun whispering to her.

"Why are you always the only one who has to keep trying so hard?"

Mizuchi desperately tried to silence that voice.

states.name: Mizuchi
states.title: Black-Hearted White Snake
states.description:
Freed from her conscience by the oni-transformation drug, now no enemy could stand before her. Her reserves of mana, which she had unconsciously held back, were now inexhaustible. In terms of pure magic prowess, she had even surpassed Rin Inugami, the foremost of the Four Masters.

"Nothing can stand in my way anymore."

And yet, there was something sorrowful in her smile.
